question: Can an exact fixed-coefficient greedy decomposition of native M11 rank-one weight factors, selected across two constructions, recover full M11 causality on a third construction while remaining selective?

searched: v17 U8 restricted M11 tensor and native factor order
valid v18 frozen-U8 and full-reader factor transfer results
temporal/is-was hidden masks, exact weight compilers, and greedy source records
AGENT_BOARD, BILIN18_CONNECTION, BENCHMARK_BACKLOG, and canonical temporal dossier
prior_art.known_result: The v17 U8 weight-norm order is selective and high-cosine on v18, but its top-32/128 magnitude recovery falls to .643/.608 on v18 A2. H3 remains construction-stable. Thus a fixed residual basis and its restricted-tensor ranking are not the invariant object, but native M11 factors may still admit a cross-construction stable subset.
prior_art.novelty: No prior run greedily decomposes the exact full M11 output delta jointly across constructions with native factor coefficients fixed to one, then causally tests the frozen order on a held-out construction. V19 has been capability-sealed but its causal outcomes stay unopened.

frozen_design.selection_population: All 16 v17 A2 rows and all 16 v18 A1 rows. These are discovery data. V18 A2/P/C are untouched by the new order until it is frozen; v19 causal outcomes remain sealed.
frozen_design.exact_factor_object: For construction c and native M11 unit n, O[c,n] is the flattened exact output contribution delta_h[c,n] times literal Down[:,n]. Its factor Gram is G_c=(H_c^T H_c) elementwise-multiplied by (Down^T Down). Normalize each G_c by the squared norm of its complete output delta so constructions receive equal weight.
frozen_design.greedy_rule: Start with zero output. At each step choose the smallest-index unselected unit maximizing the exact reduction 2*<O_n,residual>-||O_n||^2 under the equally weighted summed normalized Grams. Install every selected native factor at fixed coefficient one; never refit coefficients. Freeze the first 256 indices and report prefixes 16,32,64,128,256.
frozen_design.test: On v18 A2, compare each frozen prefix with complete M11 reader loss in both exact M11-output relative residual and downstream margin signed recovery/cosine/direction. On v18 P and C separately, normalize top-128/top-256 margin RMS by pooled target RMS. Independent writer and all-hidden formula replays remain live.

predictions.pred_a_authority_exact_gram_greedy_formu: Authorities/populations match; Gram and direct-output residual curves agree within 1e-5; writer/all-hidden margin replay is within 1e-5; all-hidden output RSE <=1e-8; hooks/finite values/39-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_crossconstruction_greedy_top128_i: The frozen top-128 exact-factor prefix has output relative residual <=.45 on both v17 A2 and v18 A1 selection constructions.
predictions.pred_c_frozen_top128_transfers_to_v18_A2: On v18 A2, top-128 output residual <=.45, signed recovery >=.80, cosine >=.95, and direction >=.875.
predictions.pred_d_frozen_top256_recovers_most_v18_A: On v18 A2, top-256 signed recovery >=.85, cosine >=.95, and direction >=.875.
predictions.pred_e_greedy_factor_program_is_selectiv: Every P/C top-128/top-256 normalized ratio <=.25, and this executor neither loads v19 rows nor opens a v19 causal outcome.

decision: C promotes a <=128 cross-construction factor program; only D promotes a broader <=256 program. If B passes but C/D fail, exact output-factor support remains construction-specific. If B fails, fixed native-factor greedy compression itself is diffuse. No failure licenses fitting on v18 A2 or opening v19; a passing prefix is frozen first, then separately confirmed on v19.
